Meta.title: The Panel
Meta.description: Pitch your business idea to a panel of AI judges and get a localized verdict.

Home.title: Pitch your idea to the panel
Home.tagline: Five AI judges question your idea, argue about it and give you an honest verdict, based on your city, not on Silicon Valley.
Home.panelIntro: Each judge looks at your idea from a different angle.

pitch.title: Pitch
pitch.body: Describe your idea, your city, your budget and how far along you are.

qa.title: Questions
qa.body: Each judge asks you one or two sharp questions.

debate.title: Debate and verdict
debate.body: The judges argue with each other, then say “I'm in” or “I'm out”.

report.title: Report
report.body: Get a visual report: can it sell, how to market it, where else it could work, and your first three steps.

Home.localTitle: Advice for where you actually are
Home.localBody: Payment habits, purchasing power, the platforms people use, local rules. A pitch from Damascus and a pitch from Mumbai get very different answers.
Home.honesty: Every number is marked as an estimate or a sourced fact.

investor.name: The Investor
investor.focus: Business model, scalability, return on investment

local.name: Local Market Expert
local.focus: Your city: demand, culture, purchasing power, rules, payments

marketing.name: Marketing Strategist
marketing.focus: Channels, ads vs influencers, content, customer cost

skeptic.name: The Skeptic
skeptic.focus: Weaknesses, risks and reasons it could fail

Boardroom.title: The boardroom
Boardroom.sceneLabel: The boardroom: five judges behind a table, and you facing them
Boardroom.seating: The panel is taking their seats…
Boardroom.question: Question
Boardroom.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

Boardroom.debateStarting: The judges turn to each other…

done.title: The panel has spoken
done.body: Your full report (sales scenarios, marketing plan, where else the idea could work and your first steps) is the next part of the show and is still being built. Your session is saved.

Pitch.title: Your pitch
Pitch.intro: Tell the panel about your idea. The more specific you are, the better their questions.

demo.title: Try a demo pitch
demo.body: No AI key is connected yet, so the panel plays pre-written sessions. Pick one to fill in the form.

idea.label: Your idea
idea.hint: What you sell, to whom, and how they pay.
idea.placeholder: Example: a weekly box of healthy lunches for office workers, ordered on WhatsApp and paid on delivery.

budget.label: Starting budget
budget.hint: Roughly how much you can spend to launch.

mode.label: How do you want to run it?

online.title: Online
online.body: App, website or social media only

hybrid.title: Hybrid
hybrid.body: Both online and a physical place
